RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: not estimable from the information provided

An all-woman panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Assigning a percentage would imply knowledge we don’t have. Your credentials justify asking how the criteria were applied, but publication counts and PhD completion may not capture every relevant qualification.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weightings, your assessment, and how the successful candidate met any essential requirements—especially whether a completed PhD was mandatory.

Check local review deadlines now; waiting for a reply may not extend them. Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges, such as sex-based comments, inconsistent standards, or departures from the advertised criteria—not simply the panel’s composition.
